verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own docs describe a public API that can be driven programmatically. They cover scoped API keys with Read/Write permissions on specific APIs, bearer-token authentication guidance written for AI agents, interactive endpoint and schema exploration, a sandbox covering the API, and an official CLI that exposes a broad slice of the API for automation. Missing for 10: a directly cited API reference page showing endpoint coverage, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the API works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: exposes a broad slice of the Airwallex API as terminal commands, so you can read and write your Airwallex resources in sandbox or production, script repeatable tasks, and wire Airwallex into automated systems
